fixes.explanation: Good guess, friend, because the law is a real and important word in the Bible. But it's a different word from the one Jesus uses, and Mark 13 never mentions it. What Jesus says has to go out to every nation is the gospel: “And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.” So law and gospel are two different words, and verse 10 gives this job to the gospel.

problems.problem: The explanation still repeats the answer and verse without clarifying the distinction between the law and the gospel.
